transactionPolicy: One outer transaction; remove only lexically identified outer BEGIN/COMMIT statements from each original source, preserving function bodies and original files separately.
assetPolicy: Rewrite included first-party CSS/JS module references to one commit-derived bundle token in generated output only. Keep original source hashes and transformed output hashes separately.
existingSitePolicy: Overlay only. Preserve STORE/PDF assets and real runtime configuration. Do not deploy the package root or use deletion mirroring.
